comment: What repo-maintenance sweeps (py/main_repo_util.py) must leave alone. Kept here, in MAM-basics, rather than as a marker file inside each frozen repo: writing such a marker would itself change the repo and destroy the very last-changed date the freeze exists to preserve. Deliberately separate from in/vendoring_policy.json, whose per-repo 'ignore' flag means 'do not scan this repo for vendoring' -- a different question from 'do not touch this repo at all'. The lists are not the same one: CCAR-Psalms is frozen here and is not ignored there, so neither may be derived from the other.

breuer-cos.comment: Superseded, not paused: Breuer's Cantillation of Scripture was merged with its history into masorah-books on 2026-07-31, and its three scripts are maintained there as py/cos/. The repo stays unarchived so its five issues keep their numbers and stay writable, and the merge was prepared in a throwaway clone precisely so this tree stayed intact -- so a reformat here would churn a frozen tree for files whose live copies are elsewhere.

CCAR-Psalms.comment: Paused client project. Not among the repos in/vendoring_policy.json ignores, which is why that flag cannot stand in for this list.

MAM-for-CCAR.comment: Paused client project. Note this one was six months rather than years old when frozen, so its last-changed date only starts testifying to the pause from here.

TMC.comment: Paused project, frozen alongside the MAM-for-* client repos.
